text.p: These were the headlines on Latvian radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- President Ulmanis nominated Economy Minister Guntar Krasts as prime minister. Most of the names on the new government list are already known.
- Talks between Ventspils Nafta and Banka Baltiya liquidator David Berry on repaying a Ventspils loan to the bankrupt bank have begun.
- Latvia's Way nominated Einar Repshe for re-election as head of the central bank.
